Native entry, initial stop, formula, direction and maximum hold remain unchanged unless the new stop executes.
online_causal_identifiability_check.certain_definition: The frozen maximum peak is at or above activation and either the later close mark or a globally timestamped post-peak trough is at or below the floor. This establishes at least one post-activation floor crossing without inventing a first-crossing time.
online_causal_identifiability_check.required_proxy_treatment: Classify each lifecycle as certain-trigger, certain-never or ambiguous. Candidate lower-bound books must assign ambiguous cases adversarially, deny all freed-capacity profit credit, and retain native close time/risk occupancy. No center advances on an optimistic or unidentified crossing.
